# Official diagnostic assessments

Planner issues one immutable `diagnostic-assessment-plan.v1` per Student and
plan revision. Student reserves, accepts one structured response per frozen
Course task, and computes a final placement-only aggregate. Course remains the
source of task definitions and answer keys; Student never exposes those keys,
submitted responses, item correctness, scorer diagnostics, feedback, mastery,
or path state through the diagnostic projection.

Each plan binds the authoritative onboarding version, exact
`diagnostic-bootstrap-v1` policy, and a bootstrap-context SHA-256 digest into
the canonical plan digest. Reservation locks and verifies the current
`student_onboarding` row before insert. A committed receipt still replays
locally after onboarding changes, but an old completed diagnostic does not
satisfy the current learning workspace or `/current` resume locator.

Reservation is Planner-token-only at
`POST /internal/v1/students/{studentID}/diagnostic-assessments/{planID}/reserve`.
Student validates the exact current active Course diagnostic catalogue using
`COURSE_DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_TOKEN`; the general Course token is not reused for
that capability. Public Student routes read an attempt, submit a frozen task,
and complete it. Every write requires exact JSON and a UUID idempotency key.
For reservation, the canonical idempotency key is the plan ID itself; the
resulting immutable attempt therefore has the same ID for deterministic pulls.

`GET /student/diagnostic-assessments/current` returns the latest deterministic
attempt for the current onboarding version. The owner may fetch a frozen AUTO
task through `GET /student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/tasks/{taskID}`;
its `student-diagnostic-assessment-task.v1` allowlist contains only question
material needed to answer. It excludes answer keys, correctness, group/source
keys, scorer data, runtime, starter and compose fields. Both reads use
`Cache-Control: no-store`; foreign/missing/not-frozen task reads are 404.

The diagnostic tables are append-only. Completion is represented by the
immutable result row, so an attempt has no mutable status. This flow is
deliberately disconnected from ordinary answers, learning actions, evidence,
mastery, progression, Course completion, and Practice.

Persisted `timestamptz` values are canonicalized back to microsecond UTC before
the immutable result digest is revalidated; wire inputs must already use the
canonical UTC form.

Completion now writes the immutable result, its completion receipt, and a
reference-only `student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1` outbox trigger in one
PostgreSQL transaction. An outbox insertion failure rolls completion back.
Exact receipt replay returns the original result without a second event.
Existing migration 014 already supports this exact subject; no new migration
is required.

The schema-version-1 envelope contains only `plan_id`, `plan_revision`,
`plan_digest`, and `result_digest` in `data`. Its correlation ID is the plan ID
(equal to the attempt ID), causation is the completion request UUID, and
`occurred_at` is the canonical immutable result completion time. The event ID
is UUID SHA1 in the URL namespace over the exact subject, a colon, and plan ID.
The relay permits this exact subject plus its prior `learning_action.closed`
subject and awaits JetStream publication acknowledgement before marking sent.
It validates diagnostic envelopes within 8KiB, including exact references,
metadata, canonical identities, unknown/duplicate/null fields, and trailing JSON.

The dedicated `STUDENT_DIAGNOSTIC_EVENTS` file workqueue has no time expiry,
unlimited message count, 1GiB capacity, discard-new behavior, a ten-minute
duplicate window, and one replica. Broker capacity failure leaves the producer
pending for retry. Planner's `ms-learning-planner-diagnostic-placement-v1`
durable validates its own frozen plan and reads the authoritative Student
aggregate before committing the existing fixed placement consequence. It ACKs
only after commit, terminates invalid mismatches, and retries transient failures
without a delivery cap. This computes placement automatically after completion;
initial planning and path allocation still require separate explicit learner
intent. No mastery, evidence, or progress fact is emitted by this trigger.

Browser/Teacher placement remains compatible recovery. Results committed before
this producer change have no trigger and are not silently backfilled. They
require the existing explicit recovery path or a separately authorized future
backfill; deployment does not rewrite historical results.
